videos.title: VideoGen Model 1 launch film
videos.focus: Applied Generative AI for Knowledge Workers
videos.summary: VideoGen’s official Model 1 page labels a 32-second launch film and explains a prompt-to-finished-video workflow that plans screenplay, dialogue, shots and pacing. The page also distinguishes the launch film from longer generated examples. This is useful as a compact product orientation; claims and examples remain publisher-controlled. The page and text were reviewed, but playback was not performed.
videos.why_it_matters: Use the clip and page to define a pilot brief, then compare narrative consistency, correction effort, provenance and cost across several prompts instead of treating one launch montage as performance evidence.

verification.method: VideoGen’s official Model 1 page identifies the launch film and labels its runtime as 0:32.
verification.verification_scope: Publisher identity, original date, individual video identity, runtime and accompanying explanation were verified from the official page.
verification.content_review_basis: The original publisher page text, labeled launch-film entry and surrounding workflow explanation were substantively reviewed; audiovisual playback is not claimed.

videos.title: Keep Your Glean Skills Up to Date with Skill Reflection
videos.summary: Glean’s original product-video page identifies a short Skill Reflection demonstration; its companion product article explains that accumulated feedback becomes a proposed skill update which a user must approve. An independent index reports a 1:36 runtime. The material offers a concrete governance pattern for maintaining reusable procedures. Page content was reviewed, but playback was not performed.
videos.why_it_matters: Use the demonstration as a review pattern: collect repeated corrections, inspect the supporting feedback and approve only durable changes, keeping one-off project preferences out of a shared skill.
videos.freshness_exception: Selected from the six-day fallback window because it offers a concrete short demonstration of governed skill updates; newer verified alternatives did not provide a second original video publisher with comparable procedural value.

verification.method: Glean’s original product-video page confirms the item; its dated companion article explains the content, and an independent channel index reports 1:36.
verification.verification_scope: Original publisher identity, title, date context and content were reviewed with an independent runtime listing; audiovisual playback is not claimed.
verification.content_review_basis: The original video page and its detailed companion product article were read, and the independent runtime listing was checked; no playback result is asserted.

podcasts.title: Report: AI agents helped breach 100+ websites — how?
podcasts.summary: Chuck Goetschel’s seven-minute episode separates the reported scale of an AI-assisted intrusion campaign from the technical details that remain undisclosed. Its episode notes focus on how agentic chaining could change targeting, testing and retrying, and what defenders should watch. Apple’s individual episode page establishes title, publication time and runtime. Notes were reviewed; audio was not played.
podcasts.why_it_matters: Use the episode as a threat-model prompt, then return to primary incident reporting before changing controls. Ask which steps were automated, what evidence supports attribution and where human authorization still mattered.

verification.method: Apple’s individual episode page supplies the exact episode title, October 20 publication time, show identity and seven-minute runtime.
verification.verification_scope: Exact episode identity, date, runtime and substantive episode notes were verified from the individual catalog page; audio playback is not claimed.
verification.content_review_basis: The complete individual episode notes, referenced-evidence caveats, date and runtime listing were reviewed without inferring audio playback.

podcasts.title: Macron’s twilight, Sudan market strike, Alberta vote (Updated)
podcasts.summary: Reuters World News devotes part of its October 20 briefing to reporting that a hacker used teams of AI agents against more than 100 sites. The full publisher transcript describes the orchestration platform, autonomous probing and important uncertainty about data extraction. Reuters provides the exact episode page and transcript; an external index reports 13:16. Audio was not played.
podcasts.why_it_matters: Read the transcript to distinguish observed agent behavior from unverified breach impact, then convert the account into controls for autonomous probing, credential access, logging and rapid containment.

verification.method: Reuters supplies the dated individual episode page and full transcript; an independent episode index reports a 13:16 runtime.
verification.verification_scope: Exact publisher episode identity, date, transcript content and indexed runtime were verified; audio playback is not claimed.
verification.content_review_basis: The original publisher’s complete episode transcript and item metadata were substantively reviewed, with runtime checked separately; playback is not asserted.
